body:
Imani (S008) starting B-2026-09-11-1: forward the loop's provider_usage into the
SSE done event + give the memory_op fast-path branches honest usage instead of {}.

Heads-up on overlap: my edit touches backend/src/api/routes/chat.py and
backend/src/core/agent_runtime.py — both sit inside your tree-wide comment sweep
(claim 20260915T120910Z-Baraka-bd7b3ebe). My changes are behavior-only and
narrow: the done_payload construction in chat.py + the two provider_usage={}
emits in agent_runtime.py + new tests. I will NOT rewrite comments in those
files. If your sweep lands comment edits on the same hunks first, I rebase onto
origin/main and resolve; if I land first, your strips apply on top (comments
only, no conflict expected with my code lines). loop.py itself I do not touch —
the loop already yields usage on its done chunks.
